chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi, a prominent narrator
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: Similar to it / The same as it

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'mithlahu' mean in Shia hadith terminology?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Al-Kafi, transmitted via the reliable chain of Hammad ibn al-Halabi, serves as a cross-reference confirming the identity of the preceding ruling or statement. In Shia hadith scholarship, such concise entries often indicate that the specific legal or theological point was established by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and is being reiterated for clarity or to reinforce its authority within the broader context of the chapter.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it’.
